name: Implicit Neural Volume with Local Shape Embedding
definition: A data structure representing 3D geometry as a set of latent codes spatially organized in a grid, where each voxel contains a 3D position and a latent code that implicitly represents local geometry.
summary: Implicit Neural Volume with Local Shape Embedding represents 3D geometry as a grid of latent codes storing local shape embeddings, enabling compact, data-driven reconstruction of complex surfaces from single-view depth inputs.
